purpose: Replay normalized VIZZ state transitions offline and reject duplicate or out-of-order sequence values before renderer integration.

activities.label: reject duplicate and out-of-order state sequences
verify active-to-neutral transitions without external applications

queries.expression: does a duplicate or delayed state fail closed instead of reusing an old adaptation
does only a valid current state produce an active bounded visual plan

assumptions: The host assigns a monotonic sequence before a state enters the renderer boundary.
The 087 normalized state and render policy remain the source of truth for this replay.
An unknown or malformed line must be visible as a failed replay rather than silently skipped.
kill_tests: Duplicate sequence must not produce an ACTIVE plan.
Out-of-order sequence must not produce an ACTIVE plan.
Low-confidence or stale state must remain neutral.
Malformed JSON must return a non-zero replay result and an explicit error.
unknowns: The actual transport ordering and loss behavior of the future host process.
Whether OSC, shared memory or another local transport will be selected after the manual TouchDesigner test.
Perceptual effect and measured latency of the final renderer.
